faqs.q: What is the price of Roasted Almonds (रोस्टेड बदाम) in Nepal?
faqs.a: NaturesMud Roasted Almonds (200 GM Glass Jar) costs Rs. 750 in Nepal (Rs. 375 per 100g). We deliver within 24–48 hours in Kathmandu Valley and across all 77 districts.

faqs.q: Should I buy Raw Almonds or Roasted Almonds?
faqs.a: Buy Raw Almonds (Rs. 750 / 200 GM) if you want to soak them overnight in water (भिजाएको बदाम) and peel the skin in the morning, or grind them for baby food. Buy Roasted Almonds (Rs. 750 / 200 GM) if you want a crunchy, ready-to-eat snack straight from the jar.

faqs.q: Are these almonds roasted in oil?
faqs.a: No—they are 100% dry-roasted in hot air without any oil, butter, or ghee.

faqs.q: How many Roasted Almonds should I eat per day?
faqs.a: A healthy daily portion is 8 to 12 almonds (about 15g–20g) per day.

faqs.q: How do I keep them crunchy during the rainy season?
faqs.a: Always close the airtight glass jar lid immediately after taking your portion and store away from kitchen steam.
